content.text:
Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/dev/case-108.json runs/dev-v2-case-108-r1

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-108-r1 --slot 0 --why "Earliest reachable slot, separates the two leading pairs 0-1 and 0-2 at max sigma, no cursor cost"
python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-108-r1 --slot 2 --why "Near-earliest reachable slot, hits max separation for both leading pairs 0-1 and 0-2 at once, minimal cursor cost"
python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-108-r1 --slot 4 --why "Earliest listed slot for the now-leading pair 1-2, also separates pair 0-2, keeps cursor thrift"
python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v2-case-108-r1 --slot 8 --why "Confirmation observation at top slot for the decisive pair 1-2, leader has not yet crossed theta"

content.text: Candidate 1 crossed theta (0.999984 ≥ 0.997). Per guidance, since it crossed after few observations, one confirmation was already taken (slot 8) at high separation for the leading pair — resolution is solid. Finalizing.

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/dev-v2-case-108-r1 --why "Candidate 1, period 11.3 days, crossed theta at support 0.999984 after a confirmation observation at the top-separation slot for the decisive pair 1-2, all rivals collapsed below 3e-5"

content.text: Campaign resolved: **candidate 1** (period ≈ 11.3 days) selected with support 0.999984 ≥ θ=0.997, using 4 of 6 observations. All other candidates collapsed to ≤3×10⁻⁵. Run saved at `runs/dev-v2-case-108-r1`.
